description: This file defines the CachedCatalogViewModelService class, which implements the ICatalogViewModelService interface. It provides cached implementations for retrieving catalog brands, types, and items, utilizing IMemoryCache to improve performance by caching results.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service class that provides cached access to catalog data such as brands, types, and catalog items, wrapping the core CatalogViewModelService with caching logic.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Returns a list of brand select list items, either from cache or by fetching fresh data via the underlying service.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Returns catalog items based on page index, size, brand, and type filters, utilizing caching to optimize repeated requests.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of type select list items, either from cache or by fetching fresh data.
